purpose: Initial claim-evidence matrix skeleton for Phase 0. Populated and maintained per Goal §14 across phases.

entries.claim: Phase 0 authority, Goal, hashes, remote refs are byte-identical and closed.
Legacy BLT results are historical evidence only and excluded from main tables.
G4_NARROW_BENCHMARK conditional; controlled comparison scope only.

Phase 1 data benchmark: RNAcentral 22 anchor, canonicalization, exact dedup, 80/80+90/90 homology clustering, family/clan split, temporal OOD (23-26) with exact+80/80 homology removal. Leakage gates: exact overlap=0, cluster-not-across-split=0.

Phase 2 unified evaluator: ScoreSums, next_base/canonical/overlap BPN, train-only tokenizer vocab, lossless round-trip, continuation/generation metrics, sealed-test gate, external adapter schema, protocol YAML. 45 fixtures PASS.
